columns.name: INTERFACE_PROPERTY_ID
columns.description: Interface Property identifier. This column constitutes primary key along with LOAD_REQUEST_ID column of the table.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: HIERARCHICAL_PROPERTY_CODE
columns.description: Property code generated by the system which captures the complete hierarchical code of the property.

columns.name: PROPERTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Attribute indicating the property number of the property.

columns.name: ACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Attribute indicating the action being performed on the property. Valid values are CREATE and UPDATE.

columns.name: PROPERTY_ID
columns.description: Attribute indicating the property identifier. This is the primary key of FLA_PROPERTIES_ALL table.

columns.name: IMPORT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the Import Job. Main Job Request ID.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status code for the property if row is processed or rejected.

columns.name: PROPERTY_START_DATE
columns.description: Attribute indicating the start date of property.

columns.name: PROPERTY_END_DATE
columns.description: Attribute indicating the end date of property.

columns.name: RESPONSIBLE_USER_NAME
columns.description: User name responsible for property.

columns.name: PROPERTY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Property type code identifying the property type.

columns.name: PROPERTY_TYPE_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Attribute indicating the code of the property type level.

columns.name: PROPERTY_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Attribute indicating the description of the property.

columns.name: BU_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the business unit name of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: INTERNAL_LOCATION_CODE
columns.description: Attribute indicating Internal location code of the property.

columns.name: INTERNAL_LOCATION_SITE_CODE
columns.description: Attribute indicating the physical location of the property.

columns.name: INTERNAL_LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Site information identifier at which the property is installed.

columns.name: PARENT_INTERFACE_PROPERTY_ID
columns.description: Interface property identifier of the parent property.

columns.name: PARENT_PROPERTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Attribute indicating the property number of the parent property.

columns.name: PROPERTY_CODE
columns.description: Attribute indicating the property code for the property.

columns.name: ROOT_PROPERTY_CODE
columns.description: Attribute indicating top level property code for the property being defined.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Active flag indicates whether the property is active or not.

columns.name: SUBLEASABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Attribute indicating whether the property is sub leasable.

columns.name: PROPERTY_SIZE
columns.description: Attribute indicating the size of the property.

columns.name: UNIT_OF_MEASURE_CODE
columns.description: Attribute indicating the unit of measure used for the size of property.

columns.name: TENURE_CODE
columns.description: Attribute indicating the tenure of the property. Valid values are LEASED and OWNED.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which property is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which property is being imported

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
